newsitem.title: FRANCE: Clarins has no comment on bond rumour.
newsitem.headline: Clarins has no comment on bond rumour.

text.p: Skincare and cosmetics firm Clarins declined to comment on Wednesday on market rumours that it was preparing to launch an issue of convertible bonds.
"We have nothing to say," a spokesman told Reuters.
Rumours circulated that Clarins was about to launch an issue of convertible bonds for 600 to 800 million francs -- a big issue relative to the firm's nine billion franc capitalisation.
Clarins said earlier on Wednesday that it would look at Sanofi's beauty products branch if energy firm Elf-Aquitaine put Sanofi up for sale.
Clarins shares were up 1.84 percent at 776 francs at 1530 GMT, well off their session high of 809 francs hit earlier in the day.
The firm on Tuesday evening said 1996 sales rose 15.8 percent and predicted double-digit profit growth for the year.
